description:
Sheriff's foreclosure sales in Dakota County, 2007 on, at or around an address. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Any foreclosures near 14000 Nicollet Ave, Burnsville?"
- "How many sheriff's sales in Dakota County since 2020?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: recent: 2020 on; all: every sale, 2007 on; crisis: 2007 to 2012. Default recent.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: foreclosures_nearby
title: Foreclosures Nearby
